title: 第20章 苏叔叔的纸条
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周六上午，安槐准时出现在苏念念家门口。

    开门的是苏正川。

    国字脸上依旧是那副万年不变的棺材板表情，灰色T恤配运动短裤，一双棉拖鞋，手里端着一杯茶。

    凝元巅峰的强者穿着这身居家打扮，总让安槐觉得像一头穿了睡衣的虎。

    “苏叔叔好。”

    “嗯，进来。”

    苏正川把他领进客厅。苏念念不在，隐约能听到二楼卫生间传来水声和走调的哼歌声，陈婉清在厨房忙活，飘出来一股葱油饼的香味。

    苏正川在沙发上坐下，从茶几上拿起一张折好的纸，递给安槐。

    安槐接过来打开。

    上面写着一行字，笔迹和苏正川本人一样，方正硬朗。

    “联邦武道馆三楼乙字区，编号0347，《固元淬体诀》中阶版，适合基础法进阶，重在经脉韧性锻炼。”

    安槐看完，心里微微一暖。

    苏正川不光推荐了功法名称，连位置编号都标好了，精确到书架区域。

    这说明他不是随便说说，而是自己专门去查过，甚至可能亲自去翻过那本书。

    “谢谢苏叔叔。”

    苏正川端茶喝了一口，面无表情地说了一句。

    “你修炼到六重之后，经脉扩展速度会大幅放缓，基础法的路径设计在六重以上效率太低，会浪费你的天赋，这本功法不算顶级，但跟你目前的经脉状态适配度最高。”

    安槐微微惊讶。

    这番话的专业程度远超日常对话里那些一个字两个字的回复，苏正川显然是认真分析过他的情况才得出的结论。

    “苏叔叔分析过我的修炼路径？”

    苏正川的茶杯在嘴边停了一下。

    “你摸底测试的时候我在场，你出手的气息运转路线有迹可循。”

    安槐恍然。摸底测试那天苏正川以教官身份在场边，安槐在演武台上跟赵啸天对练的那几秒钟，苏正川全看在眼里了。

    凝元巅峰的眼力，几秒钟就够他把一个淬体五重的气息路线看个七七八八。

    “苏叔叔费心了。”安槐认真鞠了一躬。

    苏正川嗯了一声，端着茶杯起身往书房走，到门口的时候忽然停下。

    “还有一件事。”

    “您说。”

    苏正川背对着他，声音比平时更低了几分。

    “月末排位赛的时候，念念可能会碰到硬茬，三班和一班的对阵组别里有几个四重接近五重的，她不一定打得过。”

    安槐心领神会，苏正川在告诉他，苏念念可能会输，而一个做父亲的不方便在学校里公开帮自己女儿，但他可以把信息透给安槐。

    “我知道了。”

    苏正川点了点头，走进书房，把门关上了。

    安槐看着那扇关上的门，嘴角弯了一下，苏正川对他的信任已经到了一个很微妙的程度。不是把他当外人，但也没有明确用语言表达过什么，全靠行动和偶尔蹦出来的只言片语。

    这爷俩的表达方式，一个靠揉脑袋，一个靠写字条。

    都不是正常人的沟通方式。
content_en:
On Saturday morning, An Huai appeared at the door of Su Niannian's house on time.

It was Su Zhengchuan who opened the door.

Guozi's face still has the same coffin-plate expression that has remained unchanged for thousands of years. He wears a gray T-shirt with sports shorts, a pair of cotton slippers, and a cup of tea in his hand.

The strong man at the peak of Ningyuan always made An Huai feel like a tiger in pajamas wearing this homely attire.

"Hello Uncle Su."

"Well, come in."

Su Zhengchuan led him into the living room.Su Niannian was not there, but the sound of water and off-key humming could be heard vaguely from the bathroom on the second floor. Chen Wanqing was busy in the kitchen, and the smell of scallion pancakes wafted out.

Su Zhengchuan sat down on the sofa, picked up a folded piece of paper from the coffee table, and handed it to An Huai.

An Huai took it and opened it.

There was a line of words written on it, and the handwriting was the same as Su Zhengchuan himself, square and strong.

"Area B on the third floor of the Federal Martial Arts Hall, No. 0347, the intermediate version of "Gu Yuan Body Tempering Technique", suitable for the advancement of basic methods, focusing on the toughness training of meridians."

After reading it, An Huai felt a little warm in his heart.

Su Zhengchuan not only recommended the name of the exercise, but also marked the location number, accurate to the bookshelf area.

This shows that he did not just talk about it casually, but he specifically checked it out himself, and may even have read the book himself.

"Thank you, Uncle Su."

Su Zhengchuan took a sip of tea and said expressionlessly.

"After you reach the sixth level of cultivation, the expansion speed of your meridians will slow down significantly. The path design of the basic method is too inefficient above the sixth level and will waste your talent. This method is not top-notch, but it is the most suitable for your current meridians."

An Huai was slightly surprised.

The professionalism of these words far exceeded those one-word replies in daily conversations. Su Zhengchuan obviously came to the conclusion after carefully analyzing his situation.

"Uncle Su has analyzed my cultivation path?"

Su Zhengchuan's tea cup paused near his mouth.

"I was present when you did the basic test, and the aura movement route of your attack can be traced."

An Huai suddenly realized.On the day of the basic test, Su Zhengchuan was on the sidelines as an instructor. Su Zhengchuan watched all the few seconds An Huai was sparring with Zhao Xiaotian on the martial arts stage.

With his peak Ning Yuan eyesight, a few seconds would be enough for him to see the aura path of a fifth-level body tempering person.

"Uncle Su, thank you for your trouble." An Huai bowed seriously.

Su Zhengchuan hummed, stood up and walked towards the study with the teacup in hand. He suddenly stopped when he reached the door.

"One more thing."

"You said."

Su Zhengchuan turned his back to him and his voice was a little lower than usual.

"In the qualifying match at the end of the month, Niannian may encounter some tough competition. There are a few fourth-level and close to fifth-level players in Class 3 and Class 1, and she may not be able to beat them."

An Huai understood. Su Zhengchuan was telling him that Su Niannian might lose, and it was inconvenient for a father to openly help his daughter in school, but he could reveal the information to An Huai.

"I understand."

Su Zhengchuan nodded, walked into the study, and closed the door.

An Huai looked at the closed door and curled his lips. Su Zhengchuan's trust in him had reached a very subtle level.It's not that he was treated as an outsider, but he didn't express anything clearly in words either. It all relied on actions and occasional words.

The two men express themselves by rubbing their heads and writing notes.

These are not the ways normal people communicate.
